title: Black Jack Special: Inochi o Meguru Yottsu no Kiseki
justification: Checked by episode title against TVDB series 81092 and TMDB show 238157. Its episodes are on TMDB show 238157. The node moves from TVDB 81094 to series 81092. AniDB episode 1-4 ("医者はどこだ!" (Where is a Doctor?!) to "ときには真珠のように" (Just Like a Pearl)) are TVDB S0E1 "Where is a Doctor?" to TVDB S0E4 "Just Like a Pearl" and TMDB S1E1 "医者はどこだ!" (Where is a Doctor!) to TMDB S1E4 "ときには真珠のように". TVDB series 81094 no longer exists. Both 81092 Black Jack (2004) season 0 and 439622 carry the four episodes by their Japanese titles; 81092 holds the special as the lead-in of the 2004 series and its other nodes, so the node uses it. TMDB 238157 season 1 carries the four by title, E4 by position after the three titled ones.
